visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a person's hands placing raw chicken pieces from a pink plate into a purple Le Creuset pot filled with water. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen with an induction stove. (2) The water in the pot boils vigorously, creating a layer of white foam on the surface. Chopsticks are used to lift a piece of blanched chicken to check its status. (3) The blanched chicken pieces are transferred to a stainless steel bowl of clean water. Hands rub and rinse the chicken, specifically cleaning the bone joints. (4) A woman wearing a white shirt and a pink apron stands at a yellow cutting board. She uses a kitchen knife to slice a large white onion into halves and then into chunks. (5) The camera focuses on the yellow board as the woman slices green leeks diagonally into thin pieces. The background shows kitchen utensils and a light-colored wall. (6) Slices of fresh ginger are cut into thin strips. Garlic cloves are placed on the board and smashed using the bottom of a metal pitcher before being peeled by hand. (7) The woman pours olive oil from a light blue bottle into a heated blue pot. She then uses red tongs to place the cleaned chicken pieces into the pot, skin-side down. (8) Various ingredients including chopped onions, sliced leeks, ginger strips, and smashed garlic are added to the pot with the searing chicken. The woman uses a black spatula to stir-fry everything together. (9) Hot water is poured from a metal cup into the pot, followed by rice wine. The soup is brought to a boil, and the woman skims off floating foam with a mesh strainer. (10) A light blue lid is placed on the pot. After some time, it is removed to reveal a rich, milky white broth. The woman uses a spoon to show the consistency of the soup. (11) In a separate purple pot, noodles are boiled. They are then placed in a decorative bowl with bear illustrations, topped with chicken pieces, hot soup, fresh leek slices, and white pepper. (12) The woman holds the red bowl, blows on the hot soup, and takes a big sip. She smiles, looks satisfied, and then wipes sweat from her forehead with a tissue before tying her hair up.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 帶骨雞腿肉600克 放入冷水汆燙. (2) [Subtitle]: 煮到湯上面佈滿浮末. (3) [Subtitle]: 把雞肉拿出來. (4) [Subtitle]: 放到溫水裡面清洗乾淨. (5) [Subtitle]: 骨頭縫要搓洗一下. (6) [Subtitle]: 可以先泡一下水 避免雞肉脫水..... (7) [Subtitle]: 準備兩顆洋蔥. (8) [Subtitle]: 先剖半. (9) [Subtitle]: 再切成塊狀. (10) [Subtitle]: 蒜苗斜切成片. (11) [Subtitle]: 蒜苗煮湯很甜， 也可以用青蔥...都可. (12) [Subtitle]: 老薑可以暖身 切8~10片左右... (13) [Subtitle]: 小瓣的蒜頭 8~10瓣左右 拍裂開來... (14) [Subtitle]: 去掉外皮... (15) [Subtitle]: 雞腿肉瀝乾水分... (16) [Subtitle]: 先熱鍋3分鐘， 多一點的放入橄欖油. (17) [Subtitle]: 把雞肉皮向下面. (18) [Subtitle]: 暫時不要去動它 先煎出表面焦香... (19) [Subtitle]: 接著翻炒出香氣... (20) [Subtitle]: 大概像這樣就可以了！ (21) [Subtitle]: 把洋蔥放進來... (22) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻. (23) [Subtitle]: 加入蒜苗、薑片、蒜頭. (24) [Subtitle]: 來兩撮鹽調味. (25) [Subtitle]: 綜合胡椒跟 多一些的白胡椒粉. (26) [Subtitle]: 翻炒出香氣 直到洋蔥變透明 軟化為止. (27) [Subtitle]: 先放入約600ml的熱水. (28) [Subtitle]: 讓湯先滾個3~5分鐘左右. (29) [Subtitle]: 漸漸的湯會開始乳化... (30) [Subtitle]: 加入100ml左右的米酒. (31) [Subtitle]: 繼續煮2分鐘左右 直到酒氣揮發. (32) [Subtitle]: 現在的湯色會像這樣 乳白色的樣子. (33) [Subtitle]: 這時候就可以補 1000ml左右的熱水進來. (34) [Subtitle]: 邊煮邊撈掉浮末. (35) [Subtitle]: 撈乾淨後 就可以轉小火了. (36) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋 燉煮25~30分鐘. (37) [Subtitle]: 好囉~開蓋！！❤️. (38) [Subtitle]: 湯色像這樣，超美味！❤️. (39) [Subtitle]: 一旁可以煮麵. (40) [Subtitle]: 滾了加點冷水 麵混會更Q彈！. (41) [Subtitle]: 放上雞肉，淋上熱熱的湯. (42) [Subtitle]: 趁熱放上蒜苗片 (不敢生吃，可以稍微煮一下). (43) [Subtitle]: 最後再補上白胡椒粉. (44) [Subtitle]: 超簡單，又超級好吃的 『洋蔥雞湯』就完成啦~❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 嗯~好香喔❤️❤️❤️. (46) [Subtitle]: 趕緊喝一口熱熱的湯. (47) [Subtitle]: ❤️喜歡、喜歡. (48) [Subtitle]: 天啊，還沒吃完就滿身汗！ ❤️元氣馬上上噴！❤️. (49) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody begins, accompanied by soft rhythmic percussion. The female narrator's voice is absent. The sound of water running and raw chicken being handled creates a soft, wet acoustic texture under the BGM. (2) A distinct bubbling and boiling sound emerges as the water reaches a high temperature. The sound is bright and constant, filling the mid-to-high frequency range. (3) Rhythmic, percussive chopping sounds occur as the knife hits the cutting board. Each strike is sharp with a clear transient spike. The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) A heavy metal 'clink' and 'thud' sound occurs as a pitcher smashes garlic cloves. This is immediately followed by the crisp, high-frequency rustling sound of garlic skins being peeled by hand. (5) A loud, energetic sizzling sound dominates the mix as chicken is placed in hot oil. The spectral brightness increases significantly due to the high-frequency hiss of the searing meat. (6) The sounds of metal spoons clinking against the pot and liquid being poured (water and rice wine) are layered over the continuous BGM. The sizzling transitions into a softer simmering sound. (7) The BGM swells slightly. A female voice enters at the very end of the video with a friendly, animated tone, expressing appreciation for the soup's aroma. Her pitch is moderate, and her delivery is enthusiastic. (8) Sounds of a tissue rustling and hair being tied up are audible over the final fading notes of the acoustic guitar track.
